system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, when two Thai private limited companies merge, how many forms of merger are available and what are they? Answer briefly.
raw_response:
Two. Applicable provision: Civil and Commercial Code (CCC), Section 1238 (as amended by Act Amending the CCC (No. 23) B.E. 2565 (2022), effective 7 Feb 2023). It requires that a merger take one of two forms:
- Amalgamation: both companies dissolve and form a new company that succeeds to all assets and liabilities.
- Merger by absorption: one company continues as the surviving company and succeeds to all assets and liabilities of the other, which is dissolved (see also CCC Section 1238/2).
